name: integrated-studio
description: 통합 작업실 — 마인크래프트 실행 · 데이터팩 · 모드 · 리소스팩

scripts.build:extensions: npm run build -w integrated-studio-launcher-core -w integrated-studio-theme -w integrated-studio-launcher-ui -w integrated-studio-datapack-tools -w integrated-studio-resourcepack-editor -w integrated-studio-server-host
scripts.build: npm run build:extensions && npm run build -w integrated-studio-electron
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build-python',{recursive:true})" && npm run package -w integrated-studio-electron
scripts.package:with-python: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && node scripts/bundle-python.mjs && npm run package -w integrated-studio-electron
